prompt_structure.prefix:
Input image 1 is the original static character reference for this exact species. Preserve its design, proportions, colors and body size. Input image 2 is the raw sheet A of the SAME species, used only for matching design, palette, line weight and the SAME BODY SIZE as A and the static reference. Request exactly 1024x1024 pixels. All N-direction rows must show the rear with NO visible eyes or face, including hurt and death poses. NE is a rear three-quarter view facing upper-right, clearly showing the back. SE faces lower-right, visibly distinct from E side profile. HURT must visibly recoil backward. Use only flat solid #FF00FF background; no letters, labels or drawn grid.

Match the creature design, colors, size and line weight of the second attached sheet exactly. same body size as sheet A.

Reference roles: image 1 is the identity authority: a grey-black armored crab with two large claws and six legs, no effects. Image 2 is style and body-size reference ONLY; do not inherit its incorrect poses, yaw, directions, weak hurt motion or background. For the generic four-legged body/trot template below, retain the crab anatomy from image 1 without redesigning it. NE in rows 1-4 must be rear three-quarter toward the upper right, never east profile. N in ALL rows 5-8 including hurt and death must keep the head directed away behind the shell with no face or eyes visible. Hurt recoils backward; death retains each block's heading. Exactly 44 separate figures and exactly four empty cells: R4C5, R4C6, R8C5, R8C6. No N figures or parts may bleed into row 4 blanks. Flat solid #FF00FF only.
